title: Linking words and signposting
titleVi: Từ nối và dấu hiệu dẫn dắt lập luận
description: Bộ từ nối theo chức năng: bổ sung, nhượng bộ, ví dụ, kết quả và tổng kết. Mỗi từ đều ghi rõ chức năng để bạn chọn đúng chỗ thay vì rải "moreover" khắp bài.
ieltsUse: Dùng để nối câu và nối đoạn trong Task 2, đặc biệt ở câu topic sentence, câu nhượng bộ và câu kết luận. Cũng hữu ích cho Task 1 khi mô tả xu hướng và so sánh.

words.vi: hơn nữa (chức năng: bổ sung ý mạnh hơn)
words.def: addition marker: introduces a further, usually stronger point
words.example: Moreover, remote work reduces the daily strain on urban transport systems.

words.vi: hơn thế nữa (chức năng: bổ sung, trang trọng)
words.def: addition marker: adds another supporting argument in formal writing
words.example: Furthermore, the scheme would create apprenticeships for several hundred young people.

words.vi: ngoài ra (chức năng: bổ sung)
words.def: addition marker: introduces one more item in a list
words.example: In addition, libraries offer free internet access to people without home broadband.
collocations: in addition, it should be noted

words.vi: hơn nữa, đáng nói hơn (chức năng: bổ sung kèm nhấn mạnh)
words.def: addition marker: adds a point that is more striking than the last
words.example: What is more, the policy enjoys support from both employers and trade unions.
collocations: what is more, this costs nothing

words.vi: cùng với (chức năng: bổ sung nguyên nhân thứ hai)
words.def: addition marker: together with another factor causing a result
words.example: Rising rents, coupled with stagnant wages, have pushed young families out of the centre.
collocations: coupled with a lack of funding

words.vi: tuy nhiên (chức năng: nhượng bộ)
words.def: concession marker: contrasts with the previous point without cancelling it
words.example: The evidence is limited; nevertheless, the pattern appears consistently across countries.

words.vi: dù vậy (chức năng: nhượng bộ, trang trọng)
words.def: concession marker: admits a contrary fact but keeps the main claim
words.example: The technology is expensive; nonetheless, it pays for itself within a decade.

words.vi: mặc dù (chức năng: nhượng bộ ngắn gọn trong câu)
words.def: concession marker: introduces a limiting phrase, meaning although
words.example: The reform succeeded, albeit at considerable cost to rural households.

words.vi: trong khi đó (chức năng: đối chiếu hai ý)
words.def: contrast marker: compares two facts that differ from each other
words.example: Urban households spend more on transport, whereas rural families spend more on fuel.

words.vi: bất chấp, dẫu cho (chức năng: nhượng bộ mạnh)
words.def: concession marker: despite something that might have prevented a result
words.example: Notwithstanding these objections, the council approved the housing plan.

words.vi: dù vậy (chức năng: nhượng bộ trong văn nói và viết bán trang trọng)
words.def: concession marker: acknowledges a fact but maintains a different conclusion
words.example: Even so, the gap between rich and poor districts continues to widen.

words.vi: phải thừa nhận rằng (chức năng: nhượng bộ trước khi phản biện)
words.def: concession marker: accepts a point before arguing against it
words.example: Admittedly, the initial cost is high, but maintenance is almost free.

words.vi: mặc dù vậy (chức năng: nhượng bộ)
words.def: concession marker: links a result that contradicts the previous sentence
words.example: In spite of this, enrolment in vocational courses has continued to fall.
collocations: in spite of this, it remains

words.vi: ví dụ là (chức năng: nêu ví dụ)
words.def: exemplification marker: introduces one example of a general claim
words.example: Some cities, for instance Copenhagen, have cut car use by a third.

words.vi: để minh hoạ (chức năng: nêu ví dụ minh hoạ)
words.def: exemplification marker: introduces evidence that clarifies a point
words.example: To illustrate, a single wind turbine can power roughly a thousand homes.

words.vi: một ví dụ điển hình (chức năng: nêu ví dụ tiêu biểu)
words.def: exemplification marker: an example that proves the point just made
words.example: Singapore is a case in point: congestion charging transformed its traffic within a decade.

words.vi: cụ thể là (chức năng: nêu rõ, liệt kê chính xác)
words.def: exemplification marker: specifies exactly what was just referred to
words.example: Two groups are affected, namely young graduates and unskilled workers.

words.vi: như là (chức năng: nêu ví dụ trong câu)
words.def: exemplification marker: gives examples inside a sentence
words.example: Renewable sources such as solar and wind now supply a fifth of electricity.

words.vi: do đó (chức năng: kết quả)
words.def: result marker: shows that something follows logically from the previous point
words.example: Wages stagnated for a decade; consequently, many households took on more debt.

words.vi: kết quả là (chức năng: kết quả trực tiếp)
words.def: result marker: introduces the outcome of the previous statement
words.example: Fewer people drive to work and, as a result, air quality has improved.

words.vi: vì vậy (chức năng: kết quả, suy luận)
words.def: result marker: concludes from what has been said
words.example: The sample was tiny; therefore, the findings cannot be generalised.

words.vi: vì thế, do đó (chức năng: kết quả, văn phong trang trọng)
words.def: result marker: a formal way of saying for this reason
words.example: Demand outstrips supply; hence the sharp rise in house prices.

words.vi: như vậy, vì thế (chức năng: kết quả, thường trong câu dài)
words.def: result marker: introduces a consequence or a conclusion
words.example: Investment in childcare enables more parents to work and thus raises household income.

words.vi: theo đó (chức năng: kết quả kèm hàm ý điều chỉnh hành động)
words.def: result marker: shows that an action is adjusted to fit the new situation
words.example: The risks were reassessed, and safety rules were accordingly tightened.

words.vi: tóm lại (chức năng: tổng kết)
words.def: summary marker: signals the final restatement of the main points
words.example: To sum up, the benefits of the policy outweigh its short-term costs.
